status: NON-EXECUTABLE EDITORIAL RESEARCH ONLY; not website-integrated, no final image-pixel or full rights-chain clearance
scope: Two independently source-reviewed Wikimedia Commons file pages per Norway, Finland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, including both historic urban and natural landscapes.
method: Opened ten exact Commons file pages and checked their displayed subjects, creators, stated CC BY-SA 4.0 licences and source descriptions. Compared against all existing main and editorial PR#5 Commons photo registries to avoid duplicates.
displayRequirements: Any eventual site use must show exact creator, original file-page link and licence link, indicate edits, check the actual pixels and any derivative history, and honour CC BY-SA obligations. This research file does not authorise publication without those checks.
